sessions.title: Aerobic durability + 30 sec snap
sessions.prescription: About 60 min: 12 min easy warm-up; 4×30 sec at 350–400 W with 4:30 very easy at 115–145 W after each; 23 min steady Z2 at 145–170 W; 5 min cool-down. The 30 sec efforts should be crisp, not all-out. This preserves snap while keeping the day aerobic.

sessions.title: Zwift race simulation
sessions.prescription: About 60 min total: 10 min progressive warm-up at 130–190 W with 3×10 sec openers; choose a useful 45–50 min race; 5 min easy cool-down. Race craft: stay economical, close dangerous gaps early, and make one committed 1–2 min move only when it can change position or selection. For the finish, launch earlier than instinct—the go-zone opens near 0.5 mi. If no suitable race or fatigue is abnormal, ride 60 min efficiently attached to an upper-B RoboPacer.

matchedRide.name: Zwift - Race: Stage 5 - Race - Tour of Watopia 2026 (B)

sessions.title: Long sweet spot · durability
sessions.prescription: 65–80 min total: warm up 10–15 min; 2×20 min at 220–225 W, 5 min easy between; cool down. Keep controlled and smooth; no maximal finish.

sessions.title: Threshold with attacks
sessions.prescription: 55–65 min total: warm up 12–15 min; 3×8 min blocks: repeat 2 min at 235–245 W followed by 20 sec at 325–335 W three times per block, then easy to finish each block as needed; 5 min easy between blocks; cool down. Keep recoveries controlled; reduce volume if Monday fatigue prevents good quality.

sessions.title: Aerobic endurance
sessions.prescription: 60 min steady endurance, 145–170 W, conversational, no added attacks. Shorten or ease off if fatigue is excessive.

sessions.title: Zwift race · training stimulus
sessions.prescription: Race hard when recovered, treating the race as training for Fat & Skinny Tire Fest rather than a weekly A-event. No routine taper required; choose a less intense alternative if illness or fatigue is abnormal.

matchedRide.name: Zwift - Race: Stage 1 - ZRacing - Watopia Islands - Loopipelago (B)

sessions.title: Threshold durability
sessions.prescription: 60 min: 12 min at 125–180 W; 3×10 min at 226–236 W, 4 min at 120–145 W between; 10 min at 110–135 W. Start low and hold even power.

sessions.title: Endurance + controlled repeatability
sessions.prescription: 60 min: 12 min at 125–155 W; 4×(2 min at 215–225 W, 30 sec at 300–325 W, 3:30 at 120–145 W); 16 min at 145–165 W; 8 min at 105–130 W. Keep this submaximal; if Tuesday lingers, replace repeats with conversational endurance.

matchedRide.name: Zwift - Pacer Group Ride with Jacques

sessions.title: Zwift race simulation
sessions.prescription: About 60 min: 12 min at 130–180 W including 3×10 sec at 280–320 W separated by 50 sec easy; choose ~40 min race; 8 min at 105–130 W. Draft when possible; use 2 min at 265–290 W or 30 sec at 320–360 W only when tactically useful. No mandatory extra efforts.

matchedRide.name: Zwift - Race: Stage 2 - ZRacing - Watopia Islands - The Classic (B)

sessions.title: Controlled sweet spot · aerobic durability
sessions.prescription: 55–60 min: 12 min progressive warm-up at 120–165 W; 2×12 min at 209–221 W (85–90% of FTP 246 W), with 5 min easy at 120–140 W between; finish with easy endurance/cooldown. Keep submaximal; substitute 45–60 min easy Z2 if fatigued to protect Tuesday.
